task.name: Read_generator_fuel_level
task.when: At shift start and every 2 hours during a Dominatrix shift

step.action: Inspect the ground and visible fuel connections around each generator for a leak.
step.ifThen: IF fuel is leaking or has reached the playa, THEN keep people away and immediately tell the Dominatrix and a Black Rock Ranger.

step.action: Read the fuel gauge on each generator without opening a cap or operating a control.
Tell the Dominatrix each exact gauge reading.

passWhen.criterion: No visible fuel leak is present.
The Dominatrix received the exact reading for every generator.

reasoning.entry: The workbook gives three conflicting escalation thresholds, so this task reports every exact reading until the generator owner sets one threshold.
Gauge inspection is separate from refueling and repair.
